'''Phenlass Sur''' was a [[Reesarian]] that joined the [[Resistance]] with [[Odla Sur]], to whom Phenlass was bonded and [[Marriage|married]]. The pair served as [[soldier]]s and [[scout]]s, and used their keen senses to investigate the [[jungle]] beyond the perimeter of the Resistance's [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], discovering [[Water|freshwater]] springs and fauna migratory patterns. In [[35 ABY]], the couple attended a meeting at the base where [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] revealed that the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned.

==Biography==
Phenlass Sur was a [[Reesarian]] who formed a bonded pair with fellow Reesarian [[Odla Sur]] and swore a vow of companionship as part of their [[marriage]]. The pair then joined the [[Resistance]] together and took part in its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]] as [[soldier]]s and [[scout]]s. They were part of the Resistance forces stationed at a [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], where they carried out reconnaissance on the outlying jungle beyond the perimeter of the base. Using only sound and scent, the couple detected [[Water|freshwater]] springs, and by examination of the underbrush they were able to plot migratory routes of local fauna.<ref name="TROS VD" />

[[File:Surs_at_Meeting.png|thumb|left|250px|Phenlass and Odla Sur were stationed at the Ajan Kloss Resistance base.]]
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Phenlass Sur's appearance}}</ref> the pair were standing in the base under the [[CR90 corvette]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> ''[[Tantive IV]]''<ref name="TROS VD" /> when [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], a [[Jedi]] Resistance member, returned to base following a jungle [[Jedi training|training session]] and spoke with the Resistance's leader, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Odla and Phenlass later stood under the [[cruiser]]'s [[cockpit]] while attending a meeting at the base in which [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] revealed that the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned and created the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] that would allow the First Order to take control of [[the galaxy]]. During the meeting, Odla placed a hand on Phenlass's shoulder and leaned in to speak to the Reesarian.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Phenlass Sur had precise senses, which were used in reconnaissance on Ajan Kloss. As a bonded couple, the Surs were highly attuned to each other's whereabouts. Phenlass had [[Color|red]] skin and [[hair]], which were worn in traditional Reesarian locks.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Phenlass Sur wore an outfit of various shades of brown consisting of a [[Clothing|shirt]] with a vest over it, leg bindings to keep out [[insect]]s and moisture, a pair of [[boot]]s and a [[belt]]. The Reesarian also wore two scarves, one brown and one patterned, and carried a [[blaster]] in a holster.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phenlass Sur was portrayed by [[Aidan Cook]]<ref name="Featurette">{{Film|IX}} "Cast of Creatures" featurette</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
